content.title: Taylor Frankie Paul promises a dramatic 'Bachelorette' season in newly released trailer
content.text: Taylor Frankie Paul made headlines when she was announced as the next lead of “The Bachelorette,” and if the trailer is any indication, this season won’t disappoint.On March 22, Taylor will become the first ever “Bachelorette” to not have appeared on ABC’s “The Bachelor,” and she’s clearly doing things her own way. In the trailer, host Jesse Palmer says, “This is going to be unlike any other ‘Bachelorette’ season people have ever seen before,” and he’s not kidding.Taylor Frankie Paul at "The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives" season 2 Los Angeles premiere held at Paramount Theatre on May 09, 2025 in Los Angeles, California. (Photo by JC Olivera/Variety via Getty Images)Later in the trailer, Taylor makes the shocking decision to forgo giving out roses. “I want to take all of the roses away,” she says, ultimately taking away a rose from someone who already received one. “A rose is not protecting you here,” she adds.HULU'S GET REAL HOUSE - The industry's biggest reality fans and stars alike gathered at Hulu's Get Real House in Los Angeles to celebrate the hottest unscripted shows on streaming, from "Vanderpump Villa" and "The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives" to "Dancing with the Stars" and "Bachelor in Paradise." The afternoon was filled with exclusive photo moments, in-room announcements, cast reveals and more. (Disney/Cristian Lopez)TAYLOR FRANKIE PAUL (Photo by Cristian Lopez/Disney via Getty Images)The mom-of-three seems to have pure intentions for going on the ABC dating show, saying in the trailer, “I’m ready to find my person. I do believe I was gifted this for another chapter in my life.”Taylor may be new to dating shows, but she’s no stranger to reality TV. After revealing a major scandal involving her fellow Mormon content creators, Taylor and the rest of “MomTok” became the stars of the Hulu reality show, “The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives.” There, fans watched Taylor struggle to find love and maintain a healthy relationship while raising her kids and navigating friend drama.VIDEO: Vehicle engulfed in flames on South SideTHE BACHELORETTE - ABC's "The Bachelorette” stars Taylor Frankie Paul. (Disney/Sami Drasin)Throughout “The Bachelorette” season 22 trailer, Taylor can be seen kissing various men, but fans will have to watch the season to see if she actually finds love and gets engaged.Follow us on Instagram @WeArePauseRewind for all your pop culture obsessions.
